proof.source: The collector matches the physical group-2 INSERT name to the typed target and uniquely live INSERT, verifies the source owner 0x203, and resolves NestedTargetBlock through its captured BLOCK_RECORD plus matched BLOCK/ENDBLK body and membership. The target definition is distinct from the containing AuthorityBlock, so the selected graph is not self-referential.
proof.output: For all four encoding pairs, the runtime test verifies the remapped group-1005 value, INSERT record fields and owner, NestedTargetBlock BLOCK_RECORD identity, BLOCK/ENDBLK owner relationship, and fresh typed INSERT readback. The finalizer checks the source-bound BLOCK_RECORD output and source-to-output BLOCK/ENDBLK identities.
proof.failure_retry: For each input/output encoding pair, removing the required INSERT target refuses export without replacing the destination; restoring the target succeeds on the same adapter. A separate ASCII case mutates the INSERT block name after provider emission, verifies refusal and destination preservation, restores the name, and retries successfully.
